name: cevent-audience-display
description: Track F features F2 (display time) and F3 (event audience). Design: prds/events/CBM_Events_Audience_and_Display_Design.md; hand steps and verification: cevent-audience-display-crm-handoff.md. Five new CEvent fields and one registration-source option. The display time reuses the existing CEvent.eventReleaseDate (ruling D1); it is listed so a CRM that lacks it gains it, and is skipped where it already exists (crm-test, verified 2026-09-29). Every option list is Doug's ruling: the chapters are Cleveland and Boston (D3); the teams are the roles standard's.

fields.name: audience
fields.label: Audience
fields.tooltipText: Internal: the chapter's portal calendar only. Public: the public pages and the portal. Nothing shows anywhere unless Publish To Website is ticked. Left empty, a ticked event reads as Public and an unticked one as Internal.

fields.name: publicReach
fields.label: Reach
fields.tooltipText: For a Public event: which chapters' pages should list it. Recorded now; other chapters do not show it until the shared list exists.

fields.name: reachChapters
fields.label: Chapters
fields.tooltipText: The chapters named when the reach is Selected chapters. The creating chapter is always included. Values are each chapter's short label, identical in every chapter's CRM.

fields.name: internalTeams
fields.label: Limit To Teams
fields.tooltipText: For an Internal event: only members of these teams see it on the portal. Empty means every signed-in member. This hides the event on the portal only; it does not make it private.

fields.name: takesRegistrations
fields.label: Takes Registrations
fields.tooltipText: For an Internal event: shows members a Register button on the portal.

fields.name: eventReleaseDate
fields.label: Display From
fields.tooltipText: The first moment the event may appear on any page, public or portal. Empty means as soon as Publish To Website is ticked. Registration opens at this time too.
